purpose: Check whether the official FlagEmbedding BGE-M3 finetuning route should be retried with the documented torchrun plus Deepspeed setup after v41 SIGSEGV failures.

summary: The official BGE finetuning tutorial says to install FlagEmbedding with the finetune extra and shows torchrun plus Deepspeed for finetuning.
The official embedder finetuning README confirms that teacher scores are first-class inputs through pos_scores and neg_scores.
The BGE-M3 model card and paper reinforce that the target should preserve dense, sparse, and multi-vector behavior rather than dense-only checkpoints.
ArabicMTEB/Swan remains the strongest Arabic-centric benchmark direction for final claims, while MIRACL Arabic remains the current high-signal retrieval target.

actions.action: Installed deepspeed into the existing remote virtualenv.
Synced configs/ds_stage0.json to the remote host for a documented stage-0 Deepspeed smoke.
Imported deepspeed in the remote virtualenv.
actions.error: deepspeed import fails before training because CUDA_HOME does not exist and no CUDA toolkit/nvcc is available on the host.
The same CUDA_HOME check still fails inside deepspeed ops compatibility detection.

interpretation: The official Deepspeed route is not currently runnable on hhai-zijun without installing a CUDA toolkit or switching to a CUDA-devel container.
Because the GPU itself is sufficient and idle, this is an infrastructure blocker, not a model-capacity blocker.
Spending the next round on CUDA toolkit/container setup is lower research leverage than avoiding the unstable official Trainer path.

The recommended next experiment is a custom lightweight BGE-M3 head-only distillation loop: freeze the XLM-R encoder, train only sparse_linear and colbert_linear from MIRACL Arabic labels plus the v38 hybrid teacher distribution, and evaluate with the same full MIRACL Arabic hybrid scorer.
next_experiment: Implement v43 custom BGE-M3 sparse/ColBERT head distillation smoke. Use 64-256 MIRACL train rows first, no raw data/checkpoint commits, then compare any checkpoint against the current BGE-M3 hybrid r100 full-dev score of 0.801025 only if the smoke is stable.
